revisions.note: Official wording from TPI roles.json: dead players giving you their vote token (checked 2026-09-24).

en.name: Beggar
en.ability: You must use a vote token to vote. If a dead player gives you theirs, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.
en.flavor: Alms for the poor, good Sir? Spare a coin, Madam? Thank you. God bless! You're a right kind soul and no mistake! I'll have some swanky nosh tonight, I will!

revisions.v1: You must use a vote token to vote. Dead players may choose to give you theirs. If so, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.
